messages:
nora: Quick note 7am PT: launching a newsletter + nurture for the Benchmark release. Need segment plan, send windows, and a short reminder flow. Draft here: https://app.redwood.com/campaigns/benchmark-spark-2026

ben: Proposed cohorts: trial_7d, signup_30d, thoughtlead_180d. Separate high_intent (clicked_cta) for 1-hour reminder.

sasha: Subjectline test: 3 variants across 20% sample, winner auto-applied after 8h. Also test preheader on warm cohort.

diego: Deliverability notes: cap initial ramp to 250/min regionally, include plain-text fallback, add EU privacy blurb, exclude gdpr_opt_out. Ill run seeded inbox checks.

deliverability-bot: Suppression list checked (updated 2026-03-02). Will pause if bounce >4% or spam >0.1% in 60m.

nora: Creative: hero highlights latency & cost wins, CTA = See the benchmark. Olivia uploaded HTML + text under tag v3.0.

ben: UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_spark&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Add cohort param for attribution.

sasha: Orchestration plan: NA morning, EMEA late morning local, APAC morning local. Cold drip: 0, 4, 12 days. Micro-surge 1h before webinar to high_intent only.

diego: Ill monitor first-hour metrics and post snapshot. Alert me if complaint rate >0.08% in 30m.

nora: Assign owners: sasha = orchestration, diego = deliverability, ben = tracking/reporting. Booked 11am PT QA tomorrow with ops/legal.

sasha: Segments created in test workspace. Running seeded sends now. Will update when finished.

nora: Great  thank you. Will drop final console schedule link here when live.
